correct.zh: 正确答案是ウ。软件需求定义是明确即将开发的软件「必须实现什么」（用户的要求、功能性需求）的工序，位于「怎样开发」（设计、实现）之前。本题中程序的目的是「按产品分析营业活动的成果」，因此梳理出为此必须汇总的数据项（产品名、活动名、举办日期、费用、销售额、到场人数等）需要哪些，正是确定需求的工作。只有在这里确定了所需的数据项，才能进一步研究表格的设计和宏的处理逻辑。因此ウ作为需求定义的工作是恰当的。
correct.en: The correct answer is ウ. Software requirements definition is the process of clarifying what the software to be built must achieve (the user requirements, that is, the functional requirements), and it comes before deciding how to build it (design and implementation). The purpose of the program in this question is to analyze the results of sales events for each product, so identifying which data items must be aggregated for that purpose (product name, event name, date held, cost, sales, number of visitors, and so on) is exactly the work of firming up the requirements. Only once the necessary items are decided here can the design of the table and the processing logic of the macro be examined. Therefore ウ is appropriate as a requirements definition task.

distractors.zh: 研究宏的运作逻辑并进行编码，属于需求确定之后才进行的软件设计到编程的工序。它是决定「怎样开发」的工作，与决定「开发什么」的需求定义处于不同阶段。
distractors.en: Examining the operating logic of the macro and writing the code belongs to the software design and programming processes, which are carried out after the requirements have been fixed. It decides how to build it, a different stage from requirements definition, which decides what to build.

distractors.zh: 用测试用数据试运行、检查是否能正确运作，属于确认已编写好的程序质量的测试工序。它以宏已经嵌入为前提，在需求定义阶段还无法实施。
distractors.en: Trying it out with test data to see whether it works correctly is the testing process that checks the quality of the program once it has been created. It presupposes that the macro has already been embedded, so it cannot be carried out at the requirements definition stage.

distractors.zh: 将各月的销售数据输入到电子表格软件中，是为了用完成的程序进行分析而在运行阶段所做的（数据录入）工作。如果没有确定要汇总哪些数据项，应该输入的数据也无法确定，因此它本身并不是需求定义。
distractors.en: Entering the monthly sales data for each product into the spreadsheet software is operational work (data entry) done in order to run the analysis with the finished program. Unless it has been decided which items are to be aggregated, the data to be entered cannot be determined either, so this is not requirements definition itself.

points.zh: 掌握软件生命周期（需求定义 → 设计 → 编程 → 测试 → 运行与维护）的工序划分。需求定义处理「实现什么（What）」，设计及其之后的工序处理「怎样实现（How）」。
points.en: Learn how the software life cycle is divided into processes (requirements definition, design, programming, testing, operation and maintenance). Requirements definition deals with what is to be achieved (What), while design and the later processes deal with how it is achieved (How).

points.zh: 功能性需求的梳理，是指从使用目的出发推导出系统应当处理的数据项和处理内容。从目的（按产品分析营业活动的成果）反推、确定所需的汇总项目，正是需求定义的核心。
points.en: Identifying functional requirements means deriving the data items and the processing that the system must handle from the purpose of its use. Working backward from that purpose (analyzing the results of sales events for each product) to pin down the aggregation items needed is the core of requirements definition.
